en.name: TP-Link TL-SG1008D 8-Port Switch
en.shortDescription: 8-port unmanaged gigabit switch for home and small office networks.
en.description:
## TP-Link TL-SG1008D

An 8-port unmanaged gigabit switch that plugs in and works, no configuration needed.

- Eight 10/100/1000 Mbps auto-negotiating ports
- Fanless, silent operation
- Sturdy metal casing

so.name: TP-Link TL-SG1008D 8-Port Switch
so.shortDescription: Switch 8-dekedood ah oo gigabit ah, loogu talagalay guryaha iyo xafiisyada yaryar.
so.description:
## TP-Link TL-SG1008D

Switch 8-dekedood ah oo aan la maamulin, oo gigabit ah, kaliya geli oo wuu shaqeeyaa, dejin looma baahna.

- Siddeed dekedood oo 10/100/1000 Mbps otomaatig u heshiiya
- Ma leh fan, si aamusan ayuu u shaqeeyaa
- Dabool bir ah oo adag
